scientific limitations/integrity: The scalar identifying-code number for \(K^*_{m,n}\), and therefore the balanced crown case, is prior work and is not claimed as new. The retained claim is only the complete structure and exact count of minimum codes for \(\operatorname{Cr}_n\) with \(n\ge5\). The closest same-object 2020 paper was accessible only through its publisher abstract and metadata; its inaccessible body is a residual originality risk. The proof is direct for all \(n\ge5\), while exhaustive computation through \(n=9\) is corroborative only.
title: Minimum identifying codes of crown graphs are balanced one-hole transversals
